Original note: Land or building is a short-term capital asset when held for not more than twenty-four months immediately preceding the transfer (W-088g2, D-425). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.2(42A); the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 s.3(b)(i) substituted twenty-four months for thirty-six in the opening portion, deemed w.e.f. 23-7-2024, and s.3(b)(iv) omitted the third proviso — which had given land or building twenty-four months while the opening portion said thirty-six — because the base now says it. The first proviso's twelve months is for a listed security or a unit. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.2(101)(a), a capital asset held for not more than twenty-four months, the twelve months of (b) reaching a listed security or a unit. Months are calendar months (D-303). The row carries no exchange condition: a sale of land or building is not made on a recognised stock exchange. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-21-holding-period.md rows 1, 2, 7.
